description: Defines this entity's ability to trade with players.

convert_trades_economy.description: Whether legacy trade data is converted into economy trade data.

cured_discount.description: Range of cured villager discounts applied to trade prices.

display_name.description: The entity localization key used for the trading UI display name.

hero_demand_discount.description: Additional demand discount applied while the player has Hero of the Village.

max_cured_discount.description: Maximum allowed range for cured villager discounts.

max_nearby_cured_discount.description: Most negative nearby cured villager discount allowed by legacy pricing.

nearby_cured_discount.description: Nearby cured villager discount step applied by legacy pricing.

new_screen.description: Whether this trader uses the newer trade screen implementation.

persist_trades.description: Whether generated offers are persisted with the actor save data.

show_trade_screen.description: Whether interacting with this trader opens the trade screen.

table.description: Path to the trade table JSON that defines available offers.

use_legacy_price_formula.description: Whether legacy price calculations are used instead of the newer pricing formula.
